info.description:
# Health Vault 360 (HVAPI) Enterprise Postman Collection

Welcome to the official Postman API collection for **Health Vault 360 (HVAPI)** — an enterprise clinical, identity, and care-coordination backend monolith.

## Key Highlights & Automation
- **Authentication Automation**:
  1. Call `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request` with your phone number. The returned `challengeId` is **automatically captured** into `{{challengeId}}`.
  2. Call `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify` with your OTP. The issued `accessToken` and `refreshToken` are **automatically captured** into `{{bearerToken}}` and `{{refreshToken}}`.
  3. All 400+ protected endpoints inherit `{{bearerToken}}` automatically!
  4. Call `POST /api/v1/auth/token/refresh` to automatically rotate `{{bearerToken}}`.
- **Environment & Configuration**:
  - `baseUrl`: Set to `http://localhost:3000` by default.
  - Global API Versioning: All routes prefixed with `/api/v1`.
- **27 Functional Subsystem Folders**:
  - Health & Operational Diagnostics
  - Authentication & Identity
  - Patients & Profiles
  - Doctors & Clinical Providers
  - Facilities & Medical Centers
  - Enterprise QR Subsystem
  - Health Cards & Digital Passes
  - Clinical Reports & Analytics
  - Insurance Platform & Claims
  - Content Management System (CMS)
  - Admin & Role Management
  - Family Circle Subsystem
  - Medical Records & Encounters
  - Attachments Platform
  - Immunisation Platform & Vaccines
  - Staff & Shift Management
  - Schedules, Shifts & Holidays
  - Governance & Auditing
  - Notifications & Templates
  - OCR & Document Processing (AI OCR)
  - Security, Threat Detection & Compliance
  - Observability & Telemetry Probes
  - Referral & Care Coordination
